title: Translational Engineering Research Methods
description: Introduction to qualitative, quantitative and mixed-methods used in applied engineering research and models of knowledge translation. Approaches to data collection and empirical research. Research ethics and integrity.
notes: The majority of content for this course will be taught face-to-face in a compact format during tri-annual mandatory conferences that will be attended by all students in the DEng program. Some additional course content may be delivered online.
